test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per statistics published by National Crime Records Bureau for 2020, which state registered the highest number of crimes against children [Indian Penal Code (IPC) and Special and Local Laws (SLL)]?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Crime Records Bureau report for 2020 in India**

 
 
• The **National Crime Record Bureau (NCRB) is an Indian government organisation** charged with compiling **national and state-level statistics** on **crime** as it is defined by the **Indian Penal Code and Special and Local Laws**.
 
• In **September 2021**, NCRB published its **Crime in India Report** for the previous year, **2020**.
 
• **Data** on crimes against children are covered in **Chapters 4A and 4B**. 
 
• NCRB offers data on crimes against children under** two main headings**: 
 
 
• **Indian Penal Code (IPC) **involves crimes against children
 
• Child abuse in violation of **Special and Local Laws (SLL)**
 
 
 
• As per statistics published by **National Crime Records Bureau for 2020**,** Madhya Pradesh accounts for 13% (17,008) **of the total crime against children and therefore** registered the highest number of crimes** against children in the country.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** NCRB includes** a section specifically devoted to crime against certain **vulnerable groups in the community, including women, children, Senior citizens as well as Scheduled Castes/Tribes**.
 
• The** number of crimes against children reported in 2020** was **1,28,531** compared to **1,48,185** in **2019**, a decline of **13.3%**.
 
• A total of **77,382** cases have been registered under the **IPC**, compared to **51,149 cases** under the **SLL **in the report.
